nodes.description: Mapping from NFT id (uint) to poem string, persistent storage written in constructor and read by getSeedPoemById.
Constructor that iterates over the _poems array and stores each poem in the poem mapping keyed by loop index.
Memory array of poems passed to the constructor; source of the values written into the poem mapping.
Loop counter used as the mapping key and array index inside the constructor loop.
External view function that returns the poem stored in the mapping for the given NFT id.
NFT id argument used as the lookup key into the poem mapping.

edges.reason: The _poems array parameter is consumed by the constructor loop to populate storage.
Each element of _poems is written into the poem mapping during the constructor loop.
The loop counter i is used as the mapping key for poem[i] = _poems[i].
The local counter i drives the for-loop control flow inside the constructor.
The _id parameter is passed into getSeedPoemById and used for the mapping lookup.
getSeedPoemById reads the poem mapping and returns the stored string.

normalization_plan.reason: _poems is a non-core constructor parameter whose only role is supplying values to the constructor's storage writes; it can be collapsed into the constructor node.
i is a non-core loop counter local to the constructor and carries no independent semantics beyond the constructor's iteration.
_id is a non-core parameter whose only purpose is the mapping lookup performed by getSeedPoemById, so it can be merged into that function node.
